BrochureContent.Content:
REA Hynes are delighted to present Willow Cottage, Cornaseer, Kiltoom, Athlone , an exceptional detached dormer bungalow set on an elevated and beautifully landscaped site of approximately 2,600 sq.m., enjoying breathtaking panoramic views of the surrounding countryside and the tranquil waters of Lough Ree.
Deceptively spacious and impeccably maintained, Willow Cottage offers an abundance of bright and versatile living accommodation, perfectly designed for modern family life while embracing the peace and privacy of its idyllic rural setting.
A long sweeping driveway guides you through meticulously maintained grounds, where mature trees, colourful flower beds and manicured lawns create an impressive first impression. The elevated position of the property ensures a wonderful sense of space and uninterrupted views, making this a truly special home.
The welcoming entrance hall leads to a generously proportioned lounge, where a large picture window frames the stunning front gardens and rolling countryside beyond. An attractive inset stove provides a cosy focal point, while double doors open seamlessly into the formal dining room, creating an ideal setting for both family gatherings and entertaining.
To the rear of the home, the expansive kitchen is undoubtedly the heart of the property, offering an abundance of workspace and dining potential. A practical utility room is conveniently positioned just off the kitchen, providing additional storage and functionality. A separate family room, complete with a second inset stove, enjoys dual aspect windows overlooking both the front and rear gardens, filling the room with natural light throughout the day.
The ground floor also accommodates two spacious double bedrooms, both benefiting from built-in wardrobes, together with a well-appointed family bathroom.
Upstairs, two further generously sized bedrooms each feature walk-in wardrobes and are connected by a stylish Jack and Jill bathroom. This luxurious space includes a separate shower and an elegant sunken bath, providing the perfect retreat to relax and unwind.
Outside, the exceptional gardens continue to impress. A spacious patio area extends along the rear and side of the property, ideal for al fresco dining or enjoying the peaceful surroundings. Steps lead to the elevated rear gardens, where mature shrubbery and established planting create a private oasis bursting with colour and character throughout the seasons.
Further enhancing the property is a detached garage, offering excellent storage or workshop potential.
Willow Cottage offers the rare opportunity to acquire a substantial family home combining generous accommodation, beautifully established gardens and orchards within an enviable countryside setting, all within easy reach of Athlone or Roscommon and the many amenities of Kiltoom. It offers very convenient access to the M6 motorway for easy access east or west of the country. A home of charm, warmth and timeless appeal, this is a property that must be viewed to be fully appreciated.
For further details or to arrange a viewing call REA Hynes on 0906473838 or email info@hynes.ie 

DISCLAIMER: Please note that while every effort has been made to ensure the accuracy of the property details, they are intended as a general guide and do not constitute part of an offer or contract. Prospective purchasers are advised to verify all particulars independently before making any decisions.
 

Outside
The grounds of Willow Cottage have been thoughtfully designed to provide both privacy and an idyllic setting to enjoy outdoor living. Approached by a long sweeping driveway, the property is framed by an attractive natural stone wall to the front and mature hedging that creates a wonderful sense of seclusion while enhancing its charming country appeal. Expansive lawns stretch across the front of the home, complemented by established flower beds, mature trees and colourful shrubbery that provide interest throughout the seasons. To the rear, a generous west-facing patio offers the perfect space for al fresco dining, summer entertaining or simply unwinding while taking in the peaceful surroundings and evening sunshine. Steps lead from the patio to an elevated garden, beautifully planted with mature shrubs and greenery, creating a private sanctuary with a wonderful sense of tranquillity and space. Completing the outdoor offering is a detached garage, providing excellent storage, workshop potential or secure parking, making Willow Cottage as practical as it is picturesque.

Nestled on an elevated and beautifully landscaped site extending to approximately c. 2,600 sq.m., Willow Cottage is a deceptively spacious detached dormer bungalow that enjoys spectacular views across the surrounding countryside with Lough Ree visible on the horizon.
Presented in excellent condition throughout, this impressive family home offers bright and versatile accommodation designed for comfortable modern living. The welcoming entrance hall leads to a spacious lounge featuring a large picture window overlooking the manicured front gardens and a cosy inset stove. Double doors connect seamlessly to the formal dining room, creating an ideal space for entertaining.
The heart of the home is the generous kitchen, complemented by a practical utility room, while a separate family room with a second inset stove enjoys views of both the front and rear gardens, filling the space with natural light.
The ground floor accommodates two spacious bedrooms with built-in wardrobes and a family bathroom. Upstairs, two further large bedrooms each benefit from walk-in wardrobes and share a stylish Jack & Jill bathroom complete with a separate shower and a feature sunken bath.
Outside, a long sweeping driveway leads through beautifully maintained gardens featuring mature trees, colourful flower beds and expansive lawns. Patio areas to the rear and side provide the perfect setting for outdoor dining and entertaining, while steps lead to a private rear garden filled with established shrubbery. A detached garage further enhances the property's appeal.
Offering a wonderful balance of space, privacy and scenic surroundings, Willow Cottage is an exceptional family home in one of the area's most sought-after locations, just a short drive from Athlone and all its amenities. Early viewing is highly recommended.

 Willow Cottage enjoys the perfect balance of peaceful countryside living while being conveniently located within easy reach of a wealth of local amenities and recreational facilities.
Families are well catered for with Ballybay National School just a short drive away, while the local Kiltoom GAA Club is at the heart of the community, offering excellent sporting facilities and activities for all ages.
For leisure and relaxation, the renowned Hodson Bay Hotel & Leisure Centre is nearby, providing a hotel, spa, swimming pool, gym and dining options overlooking the shores of Lough Ree. Outdoor enthusiasts will appreciate the excellent amenities at Baysports, Ireland's largest inflatable water park, where visitors can enjoy kayaking, paddleboarding, sailing and a host of water-based activities.
Golf lovers are spoiled for choice with the prestigious Athlone Golf Club located just minutes away, offering a beautifully maintained parkland course and welcoming clubhouse. The nearby Newpark Pitch & Putt Course provides an enjoyable and accessible option for golfers of all abilities in a picturesque setting.
Athlone?s Trackman Driving Range & Golf Academy is only a few minutes away.
